blind_spots.what: which short-lived or other users' process writes the internal SSD
blind_spots.reason: Each tick reads the disk counters of our own live processes (proc_pid_rusage), but a process that dies between ticks takes its counters along, and other users' counters need root; the 2026-10-04 privileged sample put ~76% of writes on our own short-lived processes
blind_spots.would_catch_if: a consented privileged sample (fs_usage or per-process rusage of every uid)

blind_spots.what: the parents of processes that live less than the 2 s window outside storms
blind_spots.reason: Births are attributed from the newborns still alive at the window's end; a storm (2,000 births/s for 2 min or kernel share 0.5) adds a 60 s census polling every 20 ms, at most every 30 min, so calm hours still lean toward longer-lived children
blind_spots.would_catch_if: an exec event stream (endpoint security, root)

blind_spots.what: idle wakeups, disk bytes and footprints of Apple and third-party items
blind_spots.reason: proc_pid_rusage of other users' processes needs root, so their cohort score counts CPU, births and launches only and lists W, D, R and M as unknown
